conclusions.details: InitialConstraintV1 constructs CharacterLevelRecord values for already attained levels only, derives the current prior HP basis, checks current life maximum, selects current feature runtime and compares its last regular start. The repeated read-only life selector does not change valid-state semantics. This respects M09's prohibition on trial character construction and historical replay; current attained-level arithmetic is not historical command replay.
